title: Staff chat alerts
adminsOnly: Only admins and owners can manage chat alerts.

howTo.slack: In Slack, create an app with Incoming Webhooks, add it to a channel and copy the webhook URL.
howTo.discord: In Discord, open the channel settings, choose Integrations, create a webhook and copy its URL.
howTo.teams: In Teams, add a Workflows webhook to the channel and copy the URL it gives you.

urlHint.teams: An https address on webhook.office.com or logic.azure.com
